content:
200 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management successfully updated the exclusion.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
string
The UUID of the exclusion.
string
The targets that you want excluded from scans. Specify multiple
targets as a comma-separated string. Targets can be in the
following formats:
An individual IPv4 address ( 192.0.2.1 )
A range of IPv4 addresses ( 192.0.2.1-192.0.2.255 )
CIDR notation ( 192.0.2.0/24 )
A fully-qualified domain name (FQDN)
( host.domain.com )
string
The name of the exclusion.
string
The description of the exclusion.
integer
The unique ID of the exclusion.
schedule
network_id
uuid
members
name
description
id
object
The schedule parameters for the exclusion.
integer
The creation date of the exclusion in Unix time.
integer
The last modification date for the exclusion in Unix time.
string
The ID of the network object associated with scanners where
Tenable Vulnerability Management applies the exclusion. The
default network ID is 00000000-0000-0000-0000-
000000000000 . To determine the ID of a custom network, use
the GET /networks endpoint. For more information about
network objects, see Manage Networks.
— 403 Returned if you do not have permission to update the exclusion.
— 404 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management could not find the specified exclusion.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
— 500 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management failed to update the exclusion.
